sec03-F12.text: For a licensed sixteen-year-old, driving is restricted between midnight and five in the morning. Exceptions are a licensed driver aged twenty-one in the front seat, an agricultural assignment, travel to or from work or a school-sponsored activity, or an emergency. For the first six months after license issuance, passengers must be immediate family; that restriction has exceptions for the same adult accompaniment, agricultural assignments and emergencies, but not work or school travel.
